command: trust
  use: trust
  short: Consent to dross running this repo's runtime.test_command on this machine
  flag: --check (bool) default="false" noopt="true" usage="exit 0 if consent is current, non-zero otherwise; prints nothing on success"
  flag: --replay (string) default="" usage="grant consent for <phase-id>'s recorded red-proof replay command instead of runtime.test_command"
  flag: --run (string) default="" usage="grant consent for `dross run <name>`'s configured command instead of runtime.test_command"
  flag: --lane (string) default="" usage="grant consent for the named [[runtime.test_lane]]'s command instead of runtime.test_command"
  flag: --lane-install (string) default="" usage="grant consent for the named [[runtime.test_lane]]'s install line — a separate grant from --lane, because installing is a different act from running a suite"
